text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...I lost.
I can no longer see the breathtaking view of the Triple Tiara.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, I won't cry.
Because...)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there,
Buena-chan~~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much for your support! 
I'm so sorry... that I couldn't live up to it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely win the next Oaks!
Please continue to cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ghk! W-What a straightforward greeting...!
Aaand, such pure determination...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista also possesses an outstanding finishing burst...!
She's the overwhelming favorite for this year's Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...
As expected, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Feelings are flowing toward you...
This really is your world, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —That is why it has to be you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: If it can be overcome... it would be nothing short of a miracle. Therefore, "that place" awaits beyond this point...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Buena Vista~~!! Great job out there!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. This attention... with all due humility,
I wonder if I might bask in its favor?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. It seems I won't be able
to show you the view from the Triple Tiara...
choice_data_list: There's still a chance to see the spectacular view.
There's still a chance to see the spectacular view!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah.
You're right."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I realized something. The view from a Classic race really is something special...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's smiles and their voices...
Everything was sparkling so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If I can move so many people's hearts with a victory...
what a wonderful sight that would be.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost. But... I'm certain now.
That an incredible view... is waiting up ahead!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's keep pushing forward like this!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race, we held a press conference.
First, after looking back on today's race—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "Regarding our future outlook, is the Oaks... really the right choice?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
In recent years, Miss Vodka conquered the Japanese Derby,
paving a new path for strong Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista-san put on a wonderful performance today as well.
Do you have plans to aim for the top of this generation?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your expectations!
However, this is the path I will follow.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "I will win the Oaks and stand at the pinnacle of the Tiara route!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So, I'm really looking forward to... taking in the wonderful scenery there now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A question for you, Trainer!
The Oaks is held at Tokyo Racecourse over 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The distance will increase significantly from today's 1600m;
how are you keeping that in mind?
choice_data_list: Moving up in distance won't be a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: She has the legs to close from anywhere and take the lead, after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what confidence!
Coming from someone who has watched closely by their side,
it must be true.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"...Judging from Buena-san's running today,
there's still plenty of room to polish her skills,
and she'll likely grow even further under Trainer-san's guidance."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I notice that the reporter's tone has changed,
becoming friendlier compared to before.
Could it be that they're starting to acknowledge me too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Well then, is there anything else—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Can you see it?
The world you are destined to reach?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon the interruption.
It will only take a moment, so please forgive me."

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire...!?
Coming all the way here... What happened...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Everyone.
Have you ever felt that there is a world
far better suited for you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have.
—And one day, I received a revelation.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
A spotlight!?
Where from...!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Allow me to share a very special secret with you all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Truth is... I am a Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yet whether by the inevitable pull of fate...
or perhaps a cruel twist of mischief...
I descended into the wrong world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, strangely enough, I understood immediately—that this was a trial bestowed upon me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Once I overcome that and prove myself a saint—
I will finally reach 'that place.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And,
that very ordeal is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san.
It is to—surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...!
I'm... a trial?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please forgive my selfishness.
However... destiny has already decided.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If I can overcome you,
I'll be able to reach the realm I aspire to...
I look forward to racing you in the Oaks as well."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan...
...Yeah, looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really get it all, but the Oaks is
going to be one fiery battle...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Heroine vs. Saint, who will emerge victorious!?"
...Fascinating. This is sure to be thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The storm brought by Red Desire seemed to have stoked
the reporters' enthusiasm. I can feel the expectations
accelerating...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's already a deeply sensitive girl.
If she gets any more worked up...
she might end up putting way too much pressure on herself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind,
I called out to warn them, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Are you completely fine?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I felt a tiny bit of tension, yeah.
But still...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You'll give me a chance to catch my breath, won't you?
Taking that into account... it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... we'll need to brace ourselves
and focus even harder for the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Because it might block the path
to the world Desire-chan wishes for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Going to a whole different world
is a really difficult thing, I think.
If I win, I'll be taking away that chance.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“The victor always bears responsibility.
I know that, but... it really is awfully heavy.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that doesn't mean... I can just hand over the victory.
I have to face this head-on."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if Desire-chan's world
is really that far away after all."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*.
You have it rough, Desire-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While managing to persuade the pure Buena Vista...
the challenge of the Yushun Himba begins.
